descriptions.zh: 好的，懂。我们明白了。你喜欢抽遗物箱！通常来说，我们会限制卖给单个客户的遗物箱数量，但是我们能够给你开个例外。从现在开始，尽享直接购买遗物箱的特权吧，只是每次所花费的§Y能量币§!会略有提升。
descriptions.en: Okay, look. We get it. You love Reliquaries! While we generally limit the amount sold to a single customer, we can make an exception for you. From now on, enjoy the privilege of purchasing Reliquaries directly, with only a nominal increase in §YEnergy Credits§! each time.

descriptions.zh:
§E圣遗物是……§R空的§!。

你尽可能压抑心中的怨念不让心中的羞恼之意浮于面部。到底是因为湿度骤增还是因为你的眼睛不受控制的湿润了？你的目光模糊了，但是空无一物的圣遗物依旧在那安然不动。

但随着一阵存在主义的黑暗吞噬过后，一切都过去了。这是什么感觉？回想起在你花费掉辛苦挣来的§H行商币§!，缓缓打开圣遗物时那种发自内心的紧张与激动……你现在充满了一种说不清道不明的§G骄傲与成就感§!。§!
descriptions.en:
§EThe Reliquary is... §Rempty§!.

Bitter disappointment claws at your insides as you struggle to maintain your composure in the face of this chance humiliation. Did humidity levels suddenly rise or are your ocular organs moistening on their own? Your vision blurs, but the emptiness of the Reliquary still stands out in sharp relief.

But as soon as an existential darkness threatens to devour you, it is swept away. What is this feeling? As you mull over the hard-earned §HCaravanCoinz§! you spent, the visceral thrill of opening the Reliquary... you are filled with an inexplicable §Gsense of pride and accomplishment§!.§!

descriptions.zh: §E是§!银河之星§E……！§!
descriptions.en: §EThe§! Galatron§E...!§!

descriptions.zh: §E圣遗物包含着一副远古图表，写满了早已失传的贸易路线，其中还包括了我们的首都恒星系§Y[Root.Capital.GetStarName]§!§!！
descriptions.en: §EThe Reliquary contains an ancient chart over long-dead trade routes, and it includes our capital system of §Y[Root.Capital.GetStarName]§!§!!

descriptions.zh:
§E 圣遗物里存放着一整套的制服。可惜的是，这些衣服的设计对象是某种比[Root.GetName]的物种更多肢体的生物。

不过，这些衣服的质料还是可以循环利用的。§!
descriptions.en:
§EThe Reliquary contains a full complement of dress uniforms. Unfortunately they were designed for a species with far more limbs than is common within the [Root.GetName].

The material might still be re-purposed, however.§!

descriptions.zh:
§E圣遗物里有炸弹！

别担心，已经拆掉了。§!
descriptions.en:
§EThe Reliquary contains a bomb!

It is swiftly defused.§!

descriptions.zh: §E圣遗物装着一篇关于爱与万物自然循环的论文。它由[Root.GetAdj]语言写成，而且文风十分现代。§!
descriptions.en: §EThe Reliquary contains a treatise on love, and the cyclical nature of all things. It is written in the [Root.GetAdj] language and the style is contemporary.§!

descriptions.zh: §E 圣遗物里存放着一把未知来历的枪械，其发射扳机明显已被破坏掉。§!
descriptions.en: §EThe Reliquary contains a gun of unknown origin, with the apparent trigger assembly removed.§!

descriptions.zh: §E圣遗物装着满满的军粮。虽然上面的所有标记都已经磨损殆尽了，但是里面的东西看起来尚且安全，而且适合[Root.GetAdj]的生理结构。§!
descriptions.en: §EThe Reliquary contains a shipment of military rations. All markings on the packaging have worn off, but the contents appear safe and compatible with [Root.GetAdj] biology.§!

descriptions.zh:
§E圣遗物里面放着音乐，虽然这盒子里并没有任何显而易见的类似播放器的东西。

圣遗物马上被关上，并且被遗忘在某个角落里面§!
descriptions.en:
§EThe Reliquary contains music, without any obvious playback mechanism.

The Reliquary is soon closed and forgotten about.§!

descriptions.zh: §E圣遗物装满了美丽的蓝色大理石。§!
descriptions.en: §EThe Reliquary is filled with beautiful blue marbles.§!

descriptions.zh:
§E圣遗物里面装着数不清的财富，如果你对不在场的人说起的话，没有人会相信这么巨量的财富会真实存在。

不过财务报表上的赤字正宣告着这个事实。§!
descriptions.en:
§EThe Reliquary is filled with untold riches. Indeed, no one present at the opening is capable of accurately describing the immense wealth, if they will even acknowledge its existence at all.

But the treasury's balance sheet spells it out clearly enough.§!

descriptions.zh: §E圣遗物里面装着几个外星设备，看上去没什么反应，应该是坏了的。§!
descriptions.en: §EThe Reliquary holds a handful of alien devices, inert and seemingly broken.§!

descriptions.zh: §E虽然是空的，但是这个圣遗物的内壁上到底都是各种印记。在更深处的地方追踪到了一些生物物质的踪迹。§!
descriptions.en: §EWhile empty, the inner walls of the Reliquary are pitted and scarred. Traces of biological material can be recovered from the deeper pockets.§!

descriptions.zh: §E 圣遗物里存放着一个只能以波频的方式存在于空灵界面的生灵。它在被发现后瞬间逃离到更高阶的位面，只在你心里留下深刻的启示与不安。§!
descriptions.en: §EThe Reliquary holds a being that exists only as a spectrum of wavelengths in an ethereal medium. It immediately escapes to a higher domain, leaving only profound revelation and paralytic fear in its wake.§!

descriptions.zh: §E圣遗物很难打开，感觉里面似乎是有一个小型的重力井阻止它打开似的。§!
descriptions.en: §EThe Reliquary is difficult to open, as it is shut tight from within by a gravitational anomaly.§!

descriptions.zh: §E圣遗物里面什么都没有。原本用于贮藏的空间被一块平滑的合金占据了，与圣遗物的内壁无缝地衔接在一起。§!
descriptions.en: §EThe Reliquary does not contain anything. Where one would expect hollow space for storage sits instead a smooth block of metal alloy, one interior wall of the Reliquary blending seamlessly into another.§!

descriptions.en: Please buy something. Anything. Just... Please.

descriptions.zh: 范格利集团中没有老板，人人都是自己的老板。虽然这确实会带来一些……管理上的麻烦。
descriptions.en: Every member of the Vengralian Trium is their own boss. This does lead to some... administrative issues.

descriptions.zh:
范格利集团的目标就是让这世界上没有难做的生意。这是范格利的立命之本。不想做生意的想法都是……

错的。

所以……
descriptions.en:
The Vengralian Trium was created for commerce. It is in the Vengralian blood-analogue. Not engaging in commerce is...

Wrong.

So...

descriptions.zh: 就算是最古老的范格利历史收据也提到了奥伦星商人。他们提升了我们，让我们的文明从孩提时代跃进到购买他们的厨房用品。
descriptions.en: Even the oldest Vengralian history-receipts tell of the Orlan Star Merchants. They elevated us from beasthood to sell us kitchen appliances.

descriptions.zh: 范格利集团的传说就是奥伦星商人的传说。他们虽然已经不在了，但是早已规定的规定的销售指标必须达成！
descriptions.en: The legacy of the Vengralian Trium is also the legacy of the Orlan Star Merchants. They are no longer with us, but the prescribed quotas must still be met!

descriptions.zh:
在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]发生了敌对行为之后，[From.From.GetName]很高兴向我们报告财富之风已被摧毁。

曾经名噪一时的拉奇行商，如今不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。这些道貌岸然的家伙以后不会再出现在我们面前了。
descriptions.en:
Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the Winds of Fortune has been destroyed.

The once-bustling Racket caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard. We shall be troubled by their sanctimonious presence no more.

descriptions.zh:
消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，据报告说财富之风已被歼灭。

在与[From.GetName]发生敌对接触之后，名噪一时的拜金教商人行商现在不过是一堆太空垃圾罢了。

对于他们侍奉的财富女神来说可真是不幸啊。
descriptions.en:
News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the Winds of Fortune is no more.

Following a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling Merchant of Numa caravan is now little more than interstellar scrapyard.

An unfortunate end for those serving the goddess of fortune herself.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，吾等卑躯现身于此不胜惶恐。我们是拜金教团，一群信奉财富女神奴玛的卑微商人。我们因贪婪而被逐出天国，因此我们现已洗心革面抛弃所有世俗的物质追求。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
descriptions.en:
Apologies for our blighted presence in the universe, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order, humble merchants serving Numa, the goddess of fortune. Cast out from the heavens for our greed, we have forsaken all earthly possessions.

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

All transactions in credits please...

descriptions.zh:
祝福你，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是拜金教团，财富女神奴玛的忠实信徒，我们来自遥远的宇宙，为你献上最为神圣的商品。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
descriptions.en:
Blessings upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order and we have come in service of Numa, the goddess of fortune, bearing most holy merchandise from distant corners of the galaxy.

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

All transactions in credits please...

descriptions.zh:
啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！财运之风最终将我带到了你美丽的地盘。我们是拜金教团，财富女神奴玛的忠实仆人，我们为你带来了受到女神祝福的货物。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
descriptions.en:
Ah, the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Finally the winds of fortune have brought us to your bountiful lands. We are the Numistic Order, faithful servants of the goddess Numa, and we have come to offer you her blessed wares.

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

All transactions in credits please...

日安，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是拜金教团，我们带来了财富女神奴玛所庇佑过的神圣货物。她一直向我们耳边呢喃，言道遥远的[Root.Capital.GetStarName]存在着一个独立的文明，齐心协力我们可成就无上的奇迹。

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

所有交易请用能量币进行……
descriptions.en:
Well met, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Numistic Order and our wares bear the holy seal of Numa, goddess of fortune. She has long whispered of a distant civilization around [Root.Capital.GetStarName] and the wonders we could achieve together.

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

All transactions in credits please...

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

Our fleets travel the divine currents of cosmic energy, wherever the winds of fortune take us, bringing new deals every time we enter your lands.

For a modest donation the wonders of the universe could be yours.

我们的舰队随财富之风航行，最终这神圣的能量指引我们来到贵领地。

只需要一点点捐赠，整个宇宙的奇观你们都可以收入囊中。

descriptions.zh: 来吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！喝下从拜金圣井中涌出的财富之水，保证你不会再渴了。
descriptions.en: Come, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Drink from the Numistic well of wealth and thirst no more.

descriptions.zh: 跟随能量币的脚步，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，它将指引你通往真相。没有什么货物能比承载着奴玛意志的货物更加神圣了……
descriptions.en: Follow the current of cosmic energy credits, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and it will take you to the truth. There is no better product than that which carries the holy seal of Numa...

descriptions.zh: 奴玛，在财富流动之时微笑。
descriptions.en: When credits pass hands, Numa smiles.

descriptions.zh:
你把那叫做公平！？你简直就是侮辱奴玛！

哦，有客人来了！很抱歉让你看到刚才那一幕。刚才的一幕很好的证明了有些人就是不配发财。
descriptions.en:
You call that a fair deal!? You spit in the face of Numa - pah!

Oh, but we have customers! Our sincerest apologies for that display. Some do not have the courage to accept good fortune when it falls into their lap.

descriptions.zh: 许多上好的货物流转到我们手中，但是我们从来不会保留这些东西。这是我们的牺牲，为了泰莎塔尔的最终建成，也为了我们的后裔能再次见到圣地。
descriptions.en: Many wondrous things pass through our hands, yet we never line our pockets. It is the sacrifice we make so that the construction of the Tessar Tarvil is completed and our children may one day see the holy land again.

descriptions.zh:
你听到了吗？硬币正叮当作响。是的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我看到了财富正在不断向你涌去。

奴玛在你的某个世界骄傲地展示了一个古龛。那个古龛将会为你带来超越你想象的财富。

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
descriptions.en:
Listen, do you hear that? It's the sound of coin trickling in. Yes, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we see great fortune coming your way.

Numa has shown us a vision of a shrine in her honor on one of your worlds. A shrine that could bring you prosperity beyond your wildest dreams.

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

descriptions.zh:
把 [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetName] 带上来。在我们穿越星系的朝圣之路中，我们拯救了许多迷失的魂灵……

看看这优秀的物种，它们接受了拜金管理之道的熏陶。看到它[fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetMouthName]深处了吗？这颜色表明它是一个十分健康的个体。他们同样十分胜任体力活。而且他们的繁殖能力十分出色。你觉得如何？

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
descriptions.en:
Bring in the [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetName]. During our pilgrimage across the galaxy we have saved many lost souls...

Look at this fine specimen, schooled in the art of Numistic administration. See the inside of his [fleet2_recent_pop_species.GetMouthName]? That color there indicates a healthy individual. They make great laborers too. And their reproductive capacities are astounding. What say you?

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

descriptions.zh:
关闭你的影像接收器，想象你正漂浮在能量币的洪流之中，而你即将抵达的，是一座满溢着更多能量币的山峰。

有了我们拜金教的成像技术，你很快就会明白，意志之力凌驾于世间任何力量。能量币将如同往低处流的水一样自然的涌向你，而你将永远地从物欲中解放出来。

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
descriptions.en:
Close your visual receptors. Now picture yourself on your back floating on a stream of energy credits towards a mountain of even more energy credits.

With our Numistic visualization techniques you will learn that there is no greater power than the power of the mind. You too will be free of material desires and credits will be drawn to you like arthropoids to dung.

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

descriptions.zh:
能量之流的图案……它们存在于各处，但无人可视。奴玛自己便可预测这神圣之潮和整个股票市场的流动。只要你愿献出一点点捐助，我们就将把她无穷智慧中的一角传授于你。

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
descriptions.en:
Patterns in the energy flow... They are everywhere yet no one sees. Numa alone can predict the divine ebb and flow of the stock market. And for a small donation, we will share some of her wisdom with you.

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

descriptions.zh:
请允许我们引见我们最棒的一个精神领袖，拥有强大思维能力同时能够看穿一切的九阶沙克瓦。在女神的指引下，你的生意将会繁荣昌盛。

而我们只希望你能提供小小的捐助……

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
descriptions.en:
May we present one of our finest spiritual leaders, a level nine Shakvah with enhanced mind focus and inner gaze. Under the goddess' guidance, business on your worlds will flourish.

All we ask is a small donation in credits...

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

descriptions.zh:
尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们将向你提供一个特别的交易……奴玛认为你的人民很有潜力，并且欢迎一部分你的子民为奴玛效忠。她将奉上无价的水晶作为回报……

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
descriptions.en:
Honored [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we have a very special offer for you... Numa has seen great potential in your people and would like to welcome some of your kind into her ranks. In return these priceless crystals could be yours...

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

descriptions.zh:
这是财富之恩惠号，我们最受信任的警戒舰……她被女神亲自选中，在星系中护送我们受祝福的货物，并曾经击退过许多渎神者——海盗、异端、虚空怪物，以及任何阻碍奴玛的神圣之道的人！如今，她仍旧几乎完好如新……

是的，她曾尽心为财富服务，而现在只需一点微不足道的捐赠，她也可以为你服务……

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
descriptions.en:
Behold Fortune's Favor, our most trusted guard ship... She was chosen by the goddess herself to escort our blessed cargo across the galaxy and has thwarted many a blasphemer in her day - pirates, infidels, monsters of the void, all who interfere with Numa's divine path! Yet she is almost as good as new...

Yes, she has served fortune well and now, for a modest donation, she may also serve you...

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

descriptions.zh:
请原谅我们的冒犯，但我们注意到你的星球，§Y[fleet2deal8planet.GetName]§!，拥有一种尚未被发掘的独特潜力。我们可以打开一道通往其神圣地心的裂口，财富就将源源不断地从中涌出！

让我们揭露你星球上隐藏的秘密吧。当然了，我们需要一笔象征性的酬劳。

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
descriptions.en:
Forgive us our intrusiveness, but we have noticed your planet, §Y[fleet2deal8planet.GetName]§!, possesses a unique potential not currently being realized. A vent can be opened to its sacred core, from whence the flow of wealth can trickle forth!

Let us reveal to you the hidden secrets of your land. We will require a nominal remuneration, of course.

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

descriptions.zh:
愿神圣的女神奴玛保佑你，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。她向我们展示了如何将你的单元更好地与§Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§!的磁场进行同调。有了我们神圣而且专利注册的§G拜金教磁条§!，你在§Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§!上的无人机将减缓对£energy£ §Y能量币§!的依赖。

作为交换，我们希望能在你的土地上举办一场献神的仪式。你意向如何？

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
descriptions.en:
The Divine Numa smiles on you this day, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. She has shown us how to better align your units to §Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§!'s magnetosphere. With our holy, patented §GNumistic Magnetostrips§!, your drones on §Y[fleet2deal9planet.GetName]§! will drain your sacred £energy£ §YEnergy Credits§! with less fervor.

In exchange, we require a ceremony to the Divine be hosted on your soil. What say you?

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

descriptions.zh:
我们的一位传教士在冥想之中被奴玛降临在她身上，迅速而含糊地说出了女神的旨意。尽管这位传教士并未活过这场考验，但我们解析了她话语中的含义，得到了一种能将一和零变为百万的算法。

不要令她的牺牲白费，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。将财富引入你们的地核，她就不会抛弃你们。

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
descriptions.en:
Deep in a meditative trance, one of our ecclesiasts gave herself over to Numa and spoke the goddess' sacred truth in a rapid stream of glossolalia. Though the ecclesiast herself did not survive her trial, we deciphered from her utterances an algorithm that can turn ones and zeros into millions.

Do not let her sacrifice be in vain, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Invite fortune into your planetary core and she will not desert you.

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

descriptions.zh:
让奴玛凝视你的灵魂吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，她就能得知你需要什么。等等……你问题的答案此刻正在我面前浮现。是的，我能看到了！

答案是……另一艘警戒舰，对吧？
descriptions.en:
Let Numa gaze into to your core, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and she will tell you what it is you need. Hold on... The answer to your problem is materializing before me. Yes, I can see it now!

It is... another guard ship, is it not?

descriptions.zh:
让奴玛凝视你的灵魂吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，她就能得知你需要什么。等等……你问题的答案此刻正在我面前浮现。是的，我能看到了！

答案是……异星天然气，不对么？嗯……真是令人陶醉的芳香！那是成功的气息！深吸一口气，你就能亲眼目睹奴玛的庄容。但是要小心，过量吸入可能会损害你的隔膜。
descriptions.en:
Let Numa gaze into to your core, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and she will tell you what it is you need. Hold on... The answer to your problem is materializing before me. Yes, I can see it now!

It's... exotic gases, is it not? Mm... and what a lovely scent they have! It is the smell of success! A deep breath of these and you will see Numa in the flesh. But be advised, excessive inhalation may dry out your membranes.

descriptions.zh:
让奴玛凝视你的灵魂吧，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，她就能得知你需要什么。等等……你问题的答案此刻正在我面前浮现。是的，我能看到了！

当然了！答案是……能量币……一直都是能量币。钱币能扭转乾坤。在你的问题上抛洒钱币，你的问题就会不见了。赞美奴玛！
descriptions.en:
Let Numa gaze into to your core, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], and she will tell you what it is you need. Hold on... The answer to your problem is materializing before me. Yes, I can see it now!

But of course! It's... credits... always credits. Credits make the world go round. We will throw credits at your problem and your problem will disappear. Praise Numa!

descriptions.zh:
通过奴玛的指导，我们发现这些古代文物对我们的冥想很有启发性。

与它们分离的想法当然让我们感到痛苦，但我们认为你们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以通过研究它们获得很多知识。

我们需要一些高级物资，所以或许我们可以进行一个交易……？

和一直以来的一样，如果你们需要时间思考一下，我们会在离开你的领地之前进行提醒，再给你们一次接受女神慷慨馈赠的机会。
descriptions.en:
By the guiding hand of Numa, we have come across these ancient artifacts which have been very inspiring for our meditations.

The thought of parting with them of course pains us, but we feel that you [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] could learn much by studying them.

We are in need of some advanced materials, so perhaps a deal could be made..?

As always, if you need time to consider, we can notify you before we depart your territory, giving you one more chance to accept the goddess' generous offer.

descriptions.zh: 错失一次投资的机会，那将会是你犯下最大的错误，我的朋友。你确定你能承担放弃我们提议的代价吗？这是在我们离开你的领地之前的最后机会。
descriptions.en: A missed opportunity to invest, my friend, is the most expensive mistake you will ever make. Are you certain you can afford to pass up on our offer? This is your last chance before we depart your territory.

descriptions.zh: 奴玛是一位大方的女士。我们正要离开时她提醒了我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！一定要在我们离开之前给他们一生中最后一次机会！
descriptions.en: Numa is a generous mistress. We were about to leave when she reminded us - the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! They must have one last chance at the deal of a lifetime, before we leave!

descriptions.zh:
往往在某些小选择中，你的命运就已注定。在这投资一点，在那儿投资一点，终有一天会变成一笔巨大的收益。小小的水滴终将汇聚成为海洋。

命运让我们在离开之前再给你一次选择的机会。
descriptions.en:
It is in the little moments your fate is decided. A credit well spent here, a credit there, will one day make a million. Small streams meet to make an ocean.

Fate has given you one more chance to take our offer before we leave.

descriptions.zh:
啊，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你听到奴玛的召唤了吗？我们马上就要离开你们的领地了，但首先，请问你们考虑过我们的交易了吗？

好好想想吧，这也许是让你飞黄腾达的选择，否则就走向毁灭，你会如何选择？
descriptions.en:
Ah, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], do you hear Numa calling? Soon we must depart your lands, but first, have you considered our offer?

Weigh your options well, for one may set you on a path to great fortune. Another to ruin. Which will it be?

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们很快将会离开你的领地。我们将会让宇宙中的能量币指引我们前进。你考虑过我们的提议了吗？
descriptions.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Soon we will depart your territory. We must go wherever the current of cosmic energy credits takes us. Have you considered our offer?

关于发生在[From.From.solar_system.GetName]星系的敌对活动，目前[From.From.GetName]舰队很高兴地告诉我们拉奇工业公司已经被摧毁了。

曾经名声大噪的拉奇行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。今后他们再也不会来打扰我们了。
descriptions.en:
Following hostilities in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system, the [From.From.GetName] Fleet is pleased to report that the Racket Industrial Enterprise has been destroyed.

The once-bustling Racket caravan is now little more than interstellar scrap. We shall be troubled by their clattering presence no more.

titles.zh: 拉奇工业公司已被摧毁

descriptions.zh:
消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，拉奇工业公司已经不复存在了。

在与[From.GetName]发生冲突之后，曾经名声大噪的拉奇行商，现在不过是星际中漂浮的垃圾罢了。

希望这样的结果会令他们感到满意。
descriptions.en:
News has reached [Root.Capital.GetName] that the Racket Industrial Enterprise is no more.

Following a hostile encounter with the [From.GetName], the once-bustling Racket caravan is now little more than interstellar scrap.

Perhaps it is an end that would not have displeased them.

We travel the stars. We view all that glows. We gather. And we trade!

We pass through your space in peace. Only to buy, to sell, §Hkssk!§! We will offer you good deals, many things. We will speak again before we leave.

Should you call us, the Caravansary Caravan Coalition will answer.

descriptions.zh:
我已经说过了。将能源转换器重新调至辅助模式。不，不是那个能源转换器！§H嘶！§!是不是什么都要我来啊？

噢！客人啊！欢迎。我们有很多稀有的上乘的好货。穿越星际只为安全送达你手中！
descriptions.en:
I have already explained. Re-route the power converter to the auxiliary manifold. No, not that power converter! §HKssk!§! Must I do everything my--

Oh! Customers! Welcome, please. We bear many goods, we have many wares. All carted safely through the stars for your convenience!

descriptions.zh: 你喜欢合金吗，§H嘶？§!你喜欢金属或者燃气吗？辛勤的劳工？贵重的矿石？我知道你肯定会有兴趣的。
descriptions.en: Do you like alloys, §Hkssk?§! Do you like metals and gases? Hard workers? Precious minerals? Yes. We thought you might.

descriptions.zh: 噢，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这是最后一批货！你根本不敢相信，§H嘶！§!箱子里面装满了各种各样的武器。多到数不清的武器。来看看吧。
descriptions.en: Oh, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The last haul! You would not believe it, §Hkssk!§! Crates and crates overflowing with munitions. Cubic tons of it! Come, please. Look.

descriptions.zh:
真不该相信他们的，真不该和他们做买卖。肮脏的[scammer_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！§H嘶！§!

哦，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们向您致敬，你愿意和我们交易吗？
descriptions.en:
Never should have trusted them. Never should have made that deal. Filthy [scammer_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! §HKssk!§!

Oh. [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We greet you. Would you like to trade?

descriptions.zh: 这可不是什么破旧的遗物，这是一件古董！想想吧，§H嘶§!。它已经存在了多少个世纪了。而且还会一直存在下去！
descriptions.en: It is not a relic. It is an antique! Just think, §Hkssk§!. It survived this many centuries already. Built to last!

descriptions.zh:
生锈？什么生锈？

哦，那个只要刮下来就行了。刮，刮，刮。马上就变新了！
descriptions.en:
The rust? What rust?

Oh. That rust. Just scrape it off. Scrape, scrape, scrape. And good as new!

descriptions.zh:
鼠人？是的，我们知道他们。曾经我们是同族兄弟。但那是很久以前了。他们不喜欢也不承认我们比他们更优秀，更加擅长收集，寻找以及掠夺。他们流放了我们。让我们在虚空中流浪！

不过没关系。我们现在变得更强大了，即使没有他们。
descriptions.en:
Ketlings? Yes. We know of them. Our once-brethren. Generations ago, long back. They did not like, did not approve that we were cleverer than they! Better at collecting, finding, taking. Greater. They sent us away. Floating in the void!

No matter. We are stronger now, without them.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]看看你的那些点数。都快要爆出来了！让我们帮你减轻一点负担吧。让我们帮忙吧。
descriptions.en: Look at your credit silos, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Full to bursting! Please, let us lighten them. Let us assist.

descriptions.en:

我们这里还有好东西，你看，设计图！是一个非常先进，非常特别的建筑。一个§G废物回收中心§!，将你的残渣和废料变成高电流能源和有用的矿物。

We have schematics. Designs! For a building, very advanced, very unique. A §GWaste Reprocessing Center§!, to convert your scrap and waste into high-current energy and useful minerals.

descriptions.zh:
我们有一个专门为你准备的交易。独有的技术，只由拉奇工业公司打造的技术！

不知道你会不会为行星防御系统头疼，不知道怎么穿透这层系统？我们将会为你带来一个非常非常特别而且先进的技术，专门强化轰炸用的，我们称它为§G轨道垃圾发射器§!！

给我们[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal6]。我们马上将方法教给你们，§H嘶！§!你的船只很快就会得到部件升级。
descriptions.en:
We have a special offer. Inimitable technology, only developed by the Racket Industrial Enterprise!

Do you have trouble penetrating the defensive grids of planets? We can show you a way, very advanced, very technical, of improved bombardment. We call it... §Gthe Orbital Trash Disperser§!!

Give us [Root.GetFleet3CostDeal6]. Then we will show you the method, and §Hkssk!§! You will have a component to add to your ships.

descriptions.zh:
我们注意到了你在§Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!轨道上的开采站。它开采能源，对吧？我们可以帮忙。我们可以送你一颗卫星，它使用了最新的科技！我们称之为§G拉奇牌能源开采器§!！

它将留在轨道上，并增加你能从§Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!的表面上获取的£energy£§Y能量币§!。

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal7]
descriptions.en:
We have noticed your mining station in orbit of §Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!. It extracts energy, does it not? We can assist. We can grant you a satellite, one fitted with a clever technology! We call it the §GRacket Energy Extractor§!!

It will remain in orbit, and increase the amount of £energy£ §YEnergy Credits§! you can obtain from §Y[fleet3deal7planet.GetName]§!'s surface.

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal7]

descriptions.zh:
你需要§Y能量币§!，对吧？为了让那些驱动你们一族的百万电路迸发出电火花？我们可以帮忙。

我们可以用§G拉奇牌发电机调节器§!来增强你们的§Y[technician_drone.GetNamePlural]§!，使你们的§Y发电区划§!性能提升百分之二十五！只要你给我们一些好处，我们就将在§Y[fleet3deal8planet.GetName]§!上部署这些装置。

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal8]
descriptions.en:
You need §YEnergy Credits§!, do you not? To zap and spark along the million circuits that drive your kind? We can assist.

With the §GRacket Generator Regulators§!, we can heighten the capacity of your §Y[technician_drone.GetNamePlural]§! to interface with the machines in your §YGenerator Districts§! by twenty-five percent! We will deploy them on §Y[fleet3deal8planet.GetName]§!, if you grant us a small favor.

[Root.GetFleet3CostDeal8]

descriptions.zh:
我们有一艘船！一艘§G驱逐舰§!：很棒，很快，很强！装备很好！绝对不是出于某些理由才想把它甩掉的，绝对不是！没时间让你的机械师们仔细检查它了，§H嘶嘶！§!你想要这艘船，对吧？

给我们£minerals£ §R2000§!矿物，船就归你了。
descriptions.en:
We have a ship! A §GDestroyer§!: very good, fast, strong! Well-equipped! Certainly not getting rid of it for a reason, oh, no! No time to let your mechanics examine it, §Hkssk!§! You want the ship, do you not?

Give us £minerals£ §R2000§! Minerals, and the ship is yours.

label.zh: 不错。我们接受你的提议。

descriptions.zh: 我们已消灭行商联盟之家——贸易空间站堂吉。这些贪婪害虫完蛋了！
descriptions.en: We have crushed the profiteering vermin that called Tradestation Tungle home. The Caravansary Caravan Coalition is no more!

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: [From.From.GetName]已摧毁行商的贸易空间站。是否有幸存者躲过了大屠杀，我们无从得知。
descriptions.en: The Caravaneer's tradestation has been destroyed by the [From.From.GetName]. We have been unable to confirm if any survivors escaped the slaughter.

options.script: name = OK

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
喂喂？能听见吗？

太好了。你可听说所有行商的家园，贸易空间站堂吉，最近遭到了野蛮袭击？有些人就是讨厌商品和服务的自由流通！凶手以为我们已经死了，但如你所见，行商议会活下来了。

我们希望在§Y[cara_home_new_location.GetName]§!星系内重新开展活动。当然了，严格来说，如此星系就不再属于你了，但我们会补偿损失的。
descriptions.en:
Hello? Yes? Do you read?

Excellent. You may have heard that the home of all Caravaneers, Tradestation Tungle, was recently brutally attacked. Some people just hate the free movement of goods and services! Our assailants believe us dead, but the Caravansary Council survived, as you can see.

We wish to re-establish our operations in the §Y[cara_home_new_location.GetName]§! system. The system would naturally no longer be yours, then, technically, but we would make it worth your while.

label.zh: 那个星系归你了，贸易之友。
label.en: The system is yours, friends of commerce.

tooltips.en: Caravansary Caravan Coalition takes ownership of the §Y[cara_home_new_location.GetName]§! system

label.zh: 该星系是战略要地，不能交给你们。
label.en: The system is too strategically important to surrender.

label.zh: 你们的幸存叫我们不爽。快滚。

descriptions.zh: [caravaneer_home_country.GetName]在[cara_home_new_location.GetName]星系重建了贸易站，那里曾经是[From.GetAdj]的领地。
descriptions.en: The [caravaneer_home_country.GetName] has reestablished its tradestation in the [cara_home_new_location.GetName] system, formerly a [From.GetAdj] territory.

options.script: name = OK

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: [From.From.GetName]认输了，无上的银河之星已经易居我手！
descriptions.en: The [From.From.GetName] has admitted defeat, and we have wrested the glorious Galatron from their unworthy grasp!

label.en: May its gentle light shine forever.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 无视败者的癫狂咆哮，[From.GetAdj]军队接管银河之星的仪式不过平淡无奇。
descriptions.en: Aside from numerous functionaries breaking down into hysterics during the handover, the surrendering of the Galatron to [From.GetAdj] forces was an uneventful affair.

label.zh: 千言万语尽化作无声愤怒。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 生活与其说是一场竞赛，不如说是碰运气。
descriptions.en: Life is more of a lottery than a competition.

descriptions.zh: 塞翁失马，焉知非福。
descriptions.en: Sometimes buckets weigh more than they have to.

descriptions.zh: 彼之砒霜，他之蜜糖
descriptions.en: One sapient's garbage is another sapient's treasure.

descriptions.zh: 不良能量币信贷总是会出现。
descriptions.en: A bad energy credit always turns up.

descriptions.zh: 闪光的未必都是暗物质。
descriptions.en: All that glitters is not dark matter.

descriptions.zh: 乞丐可不应该挑肥拣瘦。
descriptions.en: Beggars can't be choosers.

descriptions.zh: 不要苛求别人送来的泽珞是否纯净。
descriptions.en: Never look a gift Zarkaluvian in the buccal cavity.

descriptions.zh: 等价交换绝非强夺。
descriptions.en: Fair exchange is no robbery.

descriptions.zh: 为溅出的泽珞哭泣是没有用的。
descriptions.en: It's no use crying over spilt Zro.

descriptions.zh: 让惩罚与罪行相称。
descriptions.en: Let the punishment fit the crime.

descriptions.zh: 种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。
descriptions.en: You reap what you sow.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 来自[pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName]的报道指出，有一批居民离开了殖民地，选择加入正穿行于我们领地的[pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName]舰队，他们表面上说是为了冒险的梦想，不过是被赤裸裸的利益熏昏了头罢了。
descriptions.en: Reports from [pops_join_caravan_planet.GetName] inform us that a number of inhabitants have left the colony to join the [pops_join_caravan_fleet.GetName] fleet passing through our territory, ostensibly drawn by dreams of adventure or the heady aroma of raw mercantilism.

descriptions.zh: [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName]传来一条紧急消息，上面说有一批[caravan_pops_join_country.GetName]的原成员目前正打算在这颗星球上寻求政治庇护。当地管理部门决定上报这一情况，让更高阶的官员定夺。
descriptions.en: An urgent missive from [caravan_pops_join_planet.GetName] explains that a number of now-former members of the [caravan_pops_join_country.GetName] seek political asylum on the planet. The local administration has seen fit to pass the decision of what to do with them up the chain of command.

descriptions.zh: 我们驻扎在[caravan_hulk_system.GetName]星系恒星基地的情报员报告说，[caravan_hulk_country.GetName]已经离去并遗弃了一艘破旧船只，现在位于中央恒星的不稳定轨道。
descriptions.en: Our starbase in the [caravan_hulk_system.GetName] system reports that the [caravan_hulk_country.GetName] fleet has evacuated and abandoned a decrepit ship, now in unstable orbit around the system's central star.

label.zh: 把它拖到我们的恒星基地进行报废处理。
label.en: Tow it to the starbase for disposal.

descriptions.zh: 大概因为是民用运输船的缘故，舰上的数据库并未按照报废规程进行完全清除。尽管在船上没有别的有价值的发现，我们的科学家仍设法获取了某种未知外星科技的部分资料。
descriptions.en: Likely due to the vessel being a civilian transport, the shipboard databases were not fully scrubbed as part of the decommissioning process. So while nothing else of value was found aboard the ship, our data scientists have managed to recover partial references to unknown alien technologies.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 今天在[disgruntled_planet.GetName]爆发了大规模抗议，由于这个星系中[xeno_fleet.GetName]的种种暴行。他们肮脏的存在侵犯到了所有有正义感的[disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]。
descriptions.en: Mass protests erupted on [disgruntled_planet.GetName] today, due to outrage over the [xeno_fleet.GetName] in the system. Their grubby presence offends all right-thinking [disgruntled_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural].

descriptions.zh: 当[welcome_fleet.GetName]按照原计划进入[pleased_planet.GetName]轨道开展简短的参观的时候，一场自发的友好行动演变成了露天市场和派对，[pleased_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]与[welcome_fleet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural]之间建立起了许多羁绊，做成了很多买卖。
descriptions.en: As the [welcome_fleet.GetName] entered the orbit of [pleased_planet.GetName] for what should have been a brief courtesy visit today, a spontaneous outbreak of goodwill turned into a combination of open-air market and party. Many bonds between [pleased_planet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural] and [welcome_fleet.owner.Species.GetNamePlural] were forged, and much trading took place.

descriptions.zh: 在[pleased_planet.GetName]与[party_host.GetNamePlural]共同待了几个月之后，有迹象表明他们之间的关系比预想的更加紧密了。他们想要留下来。
descriptions.en: In the months following the party with the [party_host.GetNamePlural] on [pleased_planet.GetName], evidence is mounting that some of the bonds formed were closer than expected. They have asked to stay.

descriptions.en: After a recent visit of the [stealing_fleet.GetName] to [stolen_from_planet.GetName] it has been noticed that a number of resources are missing from the central reserve. It is suspected that the [stealing_fleet.GetName] somehow made off with them.

descriptions.zh: 你好。我是一个收藏家，在这向你提供一个千载难逢的机会。我有一个盒子要出售，盒子当中有什么我不会泄露，我也不会给你看。你可以用3000£energy£能量币来买，然后不管里面有什么都归你了，但是一旦出手概不退换。
descriptions.en: Greetings. I am The Collector and I offer you an opportunity. I have a box for sale, a box obtained through means I will not divulge and with a content I shall not reveal. You may purchase this box for £energy£ 3000 and keep whatever it contains, but I offer no refunds.

label.zh: 你都不让我们知道箱子里面有什么就打算让我们付钱？
label.en: You expect us to pay for this box with no idea of its contents?

descriptions.zh: 经常光顾绰尔的罗盘使得[cara_border_planet.GetName]的很多人开始沉迷赌博。许多人为了筹钱继续赌下去而走上了犯罪的道路。
descriptions.en: Frequent visits to Chor's Compass have resulted in many people on [cara_border_planet.GetName] becoming addicted to gambling. Many have turned to crime in order to pay for repeated trips

descriptions.zh: [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName]来的大量[caravaneer_neighbor_species.GetName]观光客在[cara_border_planet.GetName]上演变成了一个巨大的派对。然而“派对”开着开着却出了问题，现在变成了一场全球暴动。
descriptions.en: A visit by a large number of [caravaneer_neighbor_species.GetName] from the [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName] has resulted in a massive party on [cara_border_planet.GetName]. Unfortunately, things have gotten out of hand and the "party" now resembles a planet-wide riot.

descriptions.zh: [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName]最近发布了一种全新的老虎机，这也使得[cara_border_planet.GetName]在游客的帮助下成功迎来了一次经济的突飞猛进。
descriptions.en: The [caravaneer_neighbor.GetName] recently revealed a new range of slot machines, and the increased traffic has caused an economic boom on [cara_border_planet.GetName] as visitors pass through.

descriptions.zh: 绰尔的罗盘是一个专门找刺激的地方。由于经常光顾的原因，[cara_border_planet.GetName]的公民们对于周遭事物的冷静已经到了一个前所未有的水平。
descriptions.en: Chor's Compass is a rowdy place which is not for the faint of heart. Due to frequent visits, the citizens of [cara_border_planet.GetName] have become accustomed to conditions there to an unprecedented level.

titles.zh: 巨尸乐队音乐会：百万雄尸！

descriptions.zh: [cara_border_planet.GetName]在灵能金属乐巨尸乐队的音乐会失控后陷入混乱。破坏面之广使得人们只能一点点拼凑出当时的情况。不过有一件可以确认的事情是，在演出高潮时科尔-阿赞在月球上打出了一个洞，将它给完全摧毁了。
descriptions.en: [cara_border_planet.GetName] has been left in chaos after a concert by the Psi-Metal phenomenon Megacorpse got out of hand. Reports are scrambled due to the wide-spread devastation, but one thing they all agree on is that at the height of the performance frontbeing Kel-Azaan punched a hole in the moon, destroying it utterly.

descriptions.zh: [cara_border_planet.GetName]在灵能金属乐巨尸乐队的音乐会失控后陷入混乱。破坏面之广使得人们只能一点点拼凑出当时的情况。不过有一件可以确认的事情是，在演出高潮时科尔-阿赞把他的超级吉他重重地朝地上砸去，这导致了整个区域被完全破坏。
descriptions.en: [cara_border_planet.GetName] has been left in chaos after a concert by the Psi-Metal phenomenon Megacorpse got out of hand. Reports are scrambled due to the wide-spread devastation, but one thing they all agree on is that at the height of the performance frontbeing Kel-Azaan slammed its hyper-guitar into the stage with such force the entire area was destroyed.

descriptions.zh:
巨尸乐队是企业中最伟大的灵能金属乐队。传说那些形态迥异的乐队成员——科尔-阿赞，甘荃，人类，勇达尔，和塞可达瑞——互相之间通过虚境进行交流。

这是真的。

仅仅只有少数人知道，虚境是星河之声下辖的一个绝密的超声音乐研究部门的代号。星河之声在多元宇宙中引领着音乐潮流，同时也是声波武器制造商。巨尸乐队成立的初衷是作为灵能突击部队。他们会在棘手的“会场”进行“演奏”，通过将微弱的灵能攻击性抑制术埋藏在那些公然辱骂企业的歌词下进而影响听众，高效地暗中破坏叛乱行动。

最后，音乐对于乐队成员那已经十分强大的灵能的催化效果实在过于强大，以至于不能被管理者们控制。成员们分道扬镳，只剩空壳乐队名——因为星河之声不愿意撕毁一个无比赚钱的合约。如今巨尸乐队走到哪弹到哪，只要他们觉得合适，只要那是§R金属乐§!。
descriptions.en:
MegaCorpse is the greatest psionic-metal band in corporate space. It is said that the disparate bandmates -- Kel-Azaan, Gantren, Human, Yondar, and Scyldari -- made contact through the Shroud.

This is true.

Known only to a select few, the Shroud is the code-name of a top-secret sono-musical skunkworks division of Galactic Sounds, the leading music conglomerate and sonic weapons manufacturer in the multiverse. The MegaCorpse initiative was originally developed as a psionic strike force. They would "play" difficult "venues," effectively subverting rebellious movements with overtly anti-corporate lyrics disguising subtle psionic aggression-dampening measures inflicted on the listener.

Ultimately, the catalytic effects of their music on the band's already-potent psionic powers soon proved too much for managers and executives to control. The band went rogue in all but name - as Galactic Sounds were unwilling to break a fantastically profitable contract - and today MegaCorpse play whatever and wherever they see fit, as long as it is §Rmetal§!.
